plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-MEM1): Memory add and search
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One feature (epic FR-6) spanning about 18 files. The subsystem count exceeds 6 only because the lint counts each top-level doc file (configuration/memory.mdx, configuration/mcp.mdx, docs/DASHBOARD-AUTH.md) and the generated contracts manifest as separate subsystems. The code changes are three tightly coupled layers that one tool pair needs together: the pan memory CLI, the /api/self memory routes, and the MCP tools. Splitting them into sibling issues would ship routes whose search half cannot meet AC-11.

narratives.Problem: Managed agents can record and search Overdeck memory only by running pan over Bash with the admin internal token. The epic (PAN-4927 FR-6) gives every managed agent memory_add and memory_search MCP tools over agent-token self routes. The epic's W-MEM1 steps cannot meet the issue's AC-11 as written: pan memory search --json returns observations only, a read-mode search reads the primary checkout while add writes the agent's worktree, observations default to project overdeck whatever the cwd, and type user facts need a store flag the steps never pass.
narratives.Proposal: Add a --facts flag to pan memory search that, with --json, prints one line { facts, observations }: up to 5 active matching facts per store (cwd checkout unless --project, operator, machine) without bodies, and short observations scoped to the cwd's project. Add routes/self-memory.ts with POST /api/self/memory/facts (tell) and POST /api/self/memory/search (read:state); each validates its body, builds argv only from SelfJobArg pieces, starts the pre-registered memory-add or memory-search self job in the caller's cwd, waits up to 50 s and answers 200 with selfJobAnswer. Add agent-only tools memory_add and memory_search to SELF_TOOLS. Prove AC-11 with a round-trip test that feeds the routes' exact argv into the real commander program. Document the flag, tools and routes.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing the plain pan memory search default project (overdeck) or its plain --json array shape.
- memory_edit, memory_retire, memory_show or memory_list tools.
- Committing a fact for the agent, or writing to the primary checkout from a workspace.
- Returning fact bodies in search results.
- Any change to observation extraction or ranking.
- Importing W-SELF2's startSelfJobAnswer or waiting for PAN-4937 to merge.

autoDecisions.summary: Extend pan memory search with a --facts flag instead of halting on the epic's search step.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's AC-11 is authoritative; plain --json returns observations only and has consumers (memory-facts.test.ts:527, the OKF skill), so a new opt-in flag is the only way the CLI-backed search can return facts.

autoDecisions.summary: Under --facts, project facts come from the cwd checkout unless --project is given.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan memory add writes the cwd checkout (resolveFactTarget write mode), so search must read the same store to find a fact an agent just wrote in its worktree.

autoDecisions.summary: Under --facts with no scope flag, observations come from the cwd's project (resolveProjectKeyForCwdAsync), or global outside every project.
autoDecisions.rationale: The CLI's DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID is 'overdeck' for every cwd, which is wrong for agents in other projects; the default changes only under the new flag so human usage is untouched.

autoDecisions.summary: memory_add takes an optional store field (project | user | machine); type user defaults to user and refuses project.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan memory add exits 1 for --type user without --user or --machine; the project-memory rule names --user and --machine as the doors for operator and machine facts.

autoDecisions.summary: memory_search limit is 1-20, default 10 (the epic said 1-50), and the envelope is single-line JSON with no fact bodies and short observations.
autoDecisions.rationale: A self job keeps only the last 16 KiB of stdout, so a larger result arrives as an unparseable JSON tail.

autoDecisions.summary: routes/self-memory.ts carries a private start-and-wait helper instead of importing W-SELF2's startSelfJobAnswer.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4937 is not merged on main; the issue depends only on W-SELF1, and duplicating a 12-line helper is cheaper than a cross-issue ordering dependency.

autoDecisions.summary: The route validates id with the store's MEMORY_FACT_ID ({0,79}) instead of the epic's {0,63} pattern.
autoDecisions.rationale: One authority for fact ids; a stricter route pattern would refuse ids the CLI accepts.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. In memory-facts.ts extract findMatchingFacts(query, { project?, here? }) returning { project, operator, machine } (at most MATCHING_FACTS_LIMIT each, active only) and make printMatchingFacts call it with unchanged output. In memory.ts add facts?: boolean to MemorySearchCommandOptions and the --facts option; --facts without --json exits 1 with '--facts needs --json'; under --facts with no --project/--workspace/--issue/--global/--target, search observations with project = await resolveProjectKeyForCwdAsync(process.cwd()) or global: true when null; print JSON.stringify({ facts, observations }) on one line, facts mapped to { scope, type, id, title, description, tags, file } from findMatchingFacts(query, options.project !== undefined ? { project } : { here: true }), observations mapped to { score, id, timestamp, projectId, workspaceId, issueId, actionStatus, summary, files }; the --target no-workspace branch prints the envelope with observations []. Leave the plain --json branch untouched. Regenerate the composer manifest with npm run build:cli && npm run generate:slash-commands, and document --facts in sync-sources/skills/pan-memory/SKILL.md (usage line and Notes bullet) and configuration/memory.mdx 'Search'. Write tests/unit/cli/memory-search-facts.test.ts with the six named cases from the PRD. If tests/unit/cli/memory-facts.test.ts fails to load because its projects.js mock lacks resolveProjectKeyForCwdAsync, add that export to its mock and change nothing else in that file.

items.title: Given an agent token for agent-pan-1 with workspace /w/agent-pan-1, when POST /api/self/memory/facts receives { id: 'my-fact', type: 'feedback', description: ' Decide fast. ', title: 'T', body: 'B', tags: ['a','b'] }, then the job runs argv memory add my-fact --type=feedback --description=Decide fast. --title=T --body=B --tags=a,b --json in /w/agent-pan-1 with OVERDECK_AGENT_ID=agent-pan-1 and the route returns 200 with status done

A token without agentId receives 403 not-an-agent-token, an unknown agent receives 404 agent-gone, requiredScopeFor('POST', '/api/self/memory/facts') returns tell, and with fake timers a job that never ends returns 200 status running with next wait_job after 50 s

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-4 exactly. Create tests/unit/cli/memory-self-roundtrip.test.ts with a projects.js mock that spreads importOriginal, a searchMemory mock resolving [], a temp OVERDECK_HOME, project root and workspace, and an in-process SelfJobRunner that chdirs to input.cwd and runs createMemoryCommand().exitOverride().parseAsync(input.args.slice(2), { from: 'user' }) while capturing console.log as stdout and console.error as stderr (a refusal reaches the catch because exitCli calls process.exit, which the test's spy turns into a throw; return exitCode 1 there). Use createSelfJobs({ runner }) and agent caller deps pointing at the workspace. Cover the three named cases: add then list --here then search returns the fact; a type user fact lands in the operator store and search returns it with scope user; adding an existing id returns status done with exitCode 1 and stderr mentioning already exists.
